paper_id: Wang et al. - 2011 - On multicast throughput scaling of hybrid wireless networks with general node density
title: On multicast throughput scaling of hybrid wireless networks with general node density
motivation: 理解基站基础设施能在多大程度上改善纯无线自组织网络的吞吐量
problem_framing: 在一般节点密度下分析混合无线网络的多播吞吐量的标度行为
key_insight: 混合方案的瓶颈集中在基站与普通节点之间的无线链路上(B-O links)
method_signature: 基于小区的多播路由方案，结合稀疏/密集骨干网与高斯信道模型
evaluation_criteria: 网络吞吐量随节点数趋于无穷时的渐进标度律
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 即使对纯无线网络，高斯信道模型下的多播容量上下界仍未匹配
evidence_for_taste: the bottlenecks are both located on the wireless links between the ad hoc nodes and BSs
we purposely derive the multicast throughput without considering the possible bottlenecks on the B-O links
we expect that these results can be directly exploited in the future work
thinking_moves: 将扩展网络和密集网络统一为一般节点密度的特例
识别并隔离关键瓶颈(B-O链路)以指导后续研究
从组合优化角度选择最优多播方案
cites_own_work: C. Wang et al. (2009) IEEE INFOCOM
